title: Came disassembled, impossible to assemble
text: Came disassembled, impossible to assemble. For some reason, this came with the button piece not properly assembled in the can opener. My friend has one of these identical ones, so that's how I knew how it was supposed to come. Using hers as a reference, we determined that it is pretty much impossible to assemble it in order to actually use it. We tried separating the handle with a lot of force and pliers and it wouldn't budge at all. Would love to be sent a replacement.
